chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from Muthannā al-Ḥannāṭ, from al-Ḥasan al-Ṣayqal, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The menstruating woman performs ghusl with nine ratls of water.”

key_terms.أَرْطَالٍ: ratls, a unit of weight or measure

ai.seo_question: How much water is used for the ghusl of a menstruating woman according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the amount of water used for ghusl by a menstruating woman. It falls under the jurisprudential rulings of ritual purity related to menstruation.
